pr.body:
### Motivation

- Address #511 and retain the unresolved printed error form under #598. The supplied-point auxiliary must use the polynomially controlled point family from paper lemma `lem:qld-4-10` when constructing the extended-line witness of `lem:qld-4-13` in `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex`.

### Description

- Repair and prove `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established_ofPointsWitness` with a polynomial error function fixed before the line error, preserving the established `C * m` factor. Derive the existing established theorem from it without changing that theorem's statement or its consumer `exists_globalPairWitness`.
- Remove the unused false printed-form supplied-point auxiliary after checking callers; retain its obstruction and provenance in the gap note and audit.
- Keep `exists_extendedLinesWitness` with its printed error expression and tracked `sorry`. Its source-labelled blueprint entry remains unfinished. The new conditional blueprint entry states the repaired hypothesis explicitly and carries marks only for that proved conditional result.
- Preserve PR 587's quadratic obstruction contribution. The declaration-level audit is `audits/2026-09-18_combining-realignment-509-510-511.md`.

### Testing

- Exact head `7c4741629eb3b3404d209a12d42168fcfaa03f11`: all nine local CI contexts passed in 406 seconds; statement-origin was skipped by its path filter.
- Rooted blueprint axiom audit: 1660 passing declarations, zero failures and three existing statement-level warnings; no proof-level marked declaration depends on `sorryAx`.
- The repaired auxiliary, established theorem and global witness have standard axioms only. The retained printed-form declaration still depends on `sorryAx`, as documented.
- Fresh independent Opus review 5246139478 approved this exact head with zero unchecked findings after checking the full diff, paper correspondence, caller search, blueprint qualifications and axiom closures.

---
Addresses #511

# Review - PR 599 @ 7c4741629eb3b3404d209a12d42168fcfaa03f11

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: da9ed0ca23157c30399fe7ddbc964668b013888d. A statement-realignment packet of five files (+414/-144) against `main` at merge base `2e253049`: one false supplied-point domain repaired and proved, one unused duplicate deleted, one source-gap declaration retained with its `sorry`, plus blueprint node, gap note, register row and audit.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Scope checked: the full main-relative diff of `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Apply.lean`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex`, `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex`, `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md` and `audits/2026-09-18_combining-realignment-509-510-511.md`, read in full, against the main-session dispositions at lines 251-252 of the requests file. There are no earlier marked reviews on this PR, so nothing prior to re-check.

(a) Repaired statement. `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established_ofPointsWitness` now takes `(deltaQ : ℝ → ℝ) (hdeltaQ : IsPolyErr deltaQ)` before the line error is chosen and assumes `points : CombinedPointsWitness S (deltaQ ε)`. This is the shape of the issue-389 precedent `exists_combinedLinesWitness_ofPointsWitness` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines.lean:93-99`) one level up, quantifier for quantifier. It is the paper's setting, not a weakening: `references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1020-1034` states `lem:qld-4-13` for the coarse-graining of the family of `lem:qld-4-10`, whose error is `poly(eps)`, never for an arbitrary supplied point measurement, and Claim 17-1 at lines 1140-1173 retains `delta_Q` explicitly. Nor is it stronger than the callers can discharge: `exists_combinedPointsWitness` produces exactly this family, and `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` is re-derived from the conditional form in four lines. No conclusion-shaped hypothesis (A1): the hypothesis is a point witness, the conclusion an extended-line witness with the established `C * m * deltaCombine ε (md/q)`, and the dimension factor stays explicit with `C := 1` rather than absorbed. I diffed the statement blocks of `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` and the whole `exists_globalPairWitness` block against `github/main`: both are byte-identical.

(b) Deletion. My own `git grep -w exists_extendedLinesWitness_ofPointsWitness` at the head over `MIPStarRE`, `blueprint`, `docs`, `local`, `scripts` returns no Lean declaration and no `\lean{...}` entry - only the provenance sentence in the repaired docstring (`Apply.lean:115-117`), two gap-note paragraphs and historical `audits/` records, all retained. The refutation survives in `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_combined-lines-error-term.tex:218-233` (retensed to past, obstruction argument unchanged) and is restated with provenance in the new section at 493-541.

(c) Retained source gap. `exists_extendedLinesWitness` keeps the printed `poly(m^2 eps, md/q)` form and its `sorry` (the only one in the file, at line 88), with explicit gap wording at lines 61-70 saying it is neither marked proved nor removed and that no Lean argument depends on it - which I confirmed: the only other in-tree mention is a prose reference in `ErrorObstruction.lean:20`. Issue 598 is open and its "Definition of done" correctly forbids restating the declaration at the established error as a resolution.

(d) Blueprint honesty. The new `lem:qld-4-13-established-given-points` (lines 3500-3549) matches the Lean statement quantifier by quantifier: `deltaQ` fixed first, then `C > 0` and `deltaCombine`, then the setting and the point family at `deltaQ(eps)`, conclusion `C m deltaCombine(eps, md/q)`. It is an `example` environment with a `lem:` label, exactly the precedent `lem:combined-lines-given-points` at 3323 uses for the same kind of conditional formalization-only auxiliary, and its prose states outright that it does not claim the printed form and that the unrestricted form is false. Its statement and proof `\leanok` sit on a genuinely `sorry`-free proof. `lem:qld-4-13` at 1938-1985 keeps `\notready` and carries no formalization mark; `lem:qld-4-13-established`'s proof `\uses` was correctly narrowed to route through the new node. No Lean jargon in the added prose. Blueprint sync is green in CI (`local-ci/blueprint-sync`).

(e) Axioms. From a probe file outside the worktree (`lake env lean` on `/tmp`, no source touched), after `lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Combining.Apply` succeeded: `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established_ofPointsWitness`, `exists_extendedLinesWitness_established` and `exists_globalPairWitness` each depend on `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` only; `exists_extendedLinesWitness` additionally on `sorryAx`, as intended for the retained gap. No `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` anywhere in the diff.

(f) Disjointness with PR 587. This PR's gap-note hunks start at base lines 34, 215, 221, 485, 515 and 558; 587's declared region is 291-313. Disjoint, and no Lean file of 587 is touched here.

(g) CI at the exact head is green: `local-ci/summary` "all gating steps passed (406s)", with build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, paper-gaps, file-length, proof-debt and proof-evasion all success. Worktree HEAD equals the published head.

Commit subject follows `type(scope): short description` and the body carries no closing reference. The register row and the audit table agree with what the code actually does, including the `\leanok` placement column.

Not checked: the full `lake build` of the repository (CI's build step covers it); the transport of the directly indexed carrier and completed answer alphabet to the source's seed-bearing game, which is a pre-existing gap of this module and out of this PR's scope; the wider blueprint outside chapter 15. One observation, not a finding: the PR body uses What changed / Blueprint / Verification / Coordination rather than the literal Motivation / Description / Testing headings, and covers all three in substance.

pr.body:
### Motivation

- Address #524 by formalizing the approximate symmetrization argument in `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:101-132`, while retaining the printed exact-attainment assertion as an open source gap.

### Description

- Establish the boundedness and nonemptiness facts needed for the supremum defining `Game.value`, then reuse the proved given-strategy symmetrization to obtain a symmetric projective strategy for every positive slack.
- Provide the source-shaped approximate form with `eps' > eps`. Display the necessary nonempty-answer boundary in the Lean statements, docstrings, blueprint and gap note.
- Place the supporting results in `Games/Symmetrization.lean` and add a separate blueprint node for the approximate theorem. Preserve the original exact theorem's statement, tracked proof hole and unfaithful marker; its source-labelled node remains unmarked as proved.
- Retain PR 540 and its distinct obstruction evidence. This realignment does not supersede that preservation packet or claim exact attainment from a supremum.

### Testing

- Exact head `85b9792fa7f7d26508bfd48efcc2718cc510a22b`: all nine local CI contexts passed in 376 seconds; statement-origin was skipped by its path filter.
- Rooted blueprint axiom audit: 1660 passing declarations, zero failures and three existing statement-level warnings; no proof-level marked declaration depends on `sorryAx`.
- New declarations and the reused given-strategy theorem have standard axioms only. The original exact-attainment theorem retains its documented `sorryAx` dependency.
- Fresh independent Opus review 5246303210 approved the full diff with zero unchecked findings, checking the strict supremum step, nonempty-answer boundary, unchanged exact theorem, module split and blueprint qualifications. Its minor observations remain recorded as nonblocking.

# Review - PR 601 @ 85b9792fa7f7d26508bfd48efcc2718cc510a22b

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 61d0ab1e21673dd6b6a729b62e28248bbad1f777. A 7-file, 422-insertion statement realignment against base `main` (merge base 2e253049): the approximate symmetrization form is proved in a new module, the printed exact-attainment theorem is left untouched as an open source gap, and the blueprint, gap note, register and an audit record the realignment.

## Findings

- none

## Review

No earlier marked review exists on this PR, so nothing prior had to be re-checked; this is round 1.

(a) Faithfulness of the approximate statements. `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:94-99` states `val*(G) = 1 - eps`, `eps >= 0`, conclusion `val*(G,S) >= 1 - eps`; lines 101-132 prove only "by definition for any eps' > eps there exists a strategy ... val*(G,S') >= 1 - eps'" followed by Naimark dilation and the value-preserving symmetrization. `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Symmetrization.lean:151-162) reproduces that second column binder for binder: `hA : Nonempty G.Answer`, `_hε : 0 ≤ ε`, `h : G.toGame.value = 1 - ε`, `hlt : ε < ε'`, conclusion `∃ S : SymmetricStrategy G, S.toStrategy.IsProjective ∧ 1 - ε' ≤ S.toStrategy.value`. I traced the proof term by term: `exists_strategy_lt_value` is `exists_lt_of_lt_csSup` on `sSup (Set.range Strategy.value)` (the literal unfolding of `Game.value`, MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Defs.lean:556-557), the chosen `S₀` satisfies `G.value - δ < S₀.value`, and main's `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy` is applied at `ε := 1 - S₀.value`, which makes its hypothesis `1 - (1 - S₀.value) ≤ S₀.value` trivially true and returns `S.value = S₀.value`. No compactness, no limit, no closure of a strategy family, no attainment: the only supremum fact used is `exists_lt_of_lt_csSup`, which is strictly the "there exists a strategy above a strict lower bound" step of the source. The slack form `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_lt_value` (:123-137) and the eps' form are interderivable under `h`, as the blueprint claims.

Necessity of `Nonempty G.Answer`, checked independently of PR 540: `Game.value` is a totalized `sSup` over `Set.range (Strategy.value)`, so on an empty answer alphabet - where no `Strategy` exists, since a `Measurement` over an empty outcome type cannot sum to `1` on a space carrying a unit vector - the value is `sSup ∅ = 0` and the printed conclusion is false at `ε = 1`. The hypothesis is therefore a genuine boundary condition, and it is exactly the class `AGENTS.md:251-252` calls a faithful encoding ("nonemptiness of a finite type"). It is displayed in both statements, both docstrings, the blueprint node and the gap note, and it buys nothing beyond nonemptiness of the value set: `nonempty_strategy_of_nonempty_answer` only produces the one-dimensional deterministic strategy on `Unit ⊗ Unit`, so no dimension bound, no optimality and no attainment is smuggled in through it.

(b) The retained printed theorem. The block `theorem exists_symmetric_projective_strategy ... sorry` is byte-identical to `github/main` (md5 of the statement-through-`sorry` span matches on both sides). Its docstring still carries the `**Unfaithful:**` marker, updated only to name tracker 524 in place of 98 (98 is indeed in the closed state, reason completed) and to record the empty-answer defect. Blueprint `lem:symmetric-strat` is unchanged and carries neither statement nor proof `\leanok`; one sentence was appended to its proof paragraph pointing at the new node and repeating that the exact form stays an open gap. The register row and the gap note keep exact attainment open and make no completeness claim.

(c) `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy` is unchanged against `github/main` apart from being followed by one extra blank line; its proof, statement and docstring are identical.

(d) Module split: `git diff 554fc904 27219427` shows the relocated text is character-identical to what was deleted from `StrategyClasses.lean`, with only a new module docstring and `open`/`namespace` preamble added. `StrategyClasses.lean` goes 920 -> 927 lines while 920 + 138 would have passed the 1000-line guard, so the split motive checks out. `Symmetrization.lean` imports only `StrategyClasses`, and `MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean` imports it next to `StrategyClasses`; no cycle is possible and `lake env lean` on both touched files succeeds (the sole warning is the pre-existing `sorry` at StrategyClasses.lean:892).

(e) `#print axioms` from a probe file outside the worktree, elaborated against the worktree at this head: `Strategy.value_le_one`, `bddAbove_range_strategy_value`, `Strategy.value_le_game_value`, `nonempty_strategy_of_nonempty_answer`, `exists_strategy_lt_value`, `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_lt_value`, `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx` and `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy` each depend on exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`; `exists_symmetric_projective_strategy` still depends on `sorryAx`. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` is introduced.

(f) Blueprint. `lem:symmetric-strat-approx` (ch12_qpbt_games.tex:140-156) matches the Lean statement quantifier by quantifier - nonempty answer alphabet, `val*(G) = 1 - eps` with `eps >= 0`, "for every eps' > eps", conclusion `>= 1 - eps'` - and its proof paragraph describes the exact Lean route (nonempty value set, bounded above by one, supremum property, then the given-strategy lemma), so both `\leanok` marks are honest. Its "formalization-only node is not a named statement of the paper" framing follows the existing `lem:symmetric-strat-given-strategy` precedent, and naming a Lean declaration in `\texttt{}` inside blueprint prose is established house style in this repository (ch04, ch10). `local-ci/blueprint-sync`, `blueprint-render`, `paper-gaps`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion`, `file-length` and `build` are all green at this exact head (`local-ci/summary`: all gating steps passed, 376s), confirming (h).

(g) The unused `_hε : 0 ≤ ε` binder: acceptable, not a finding. Keeping the paper's side condition makes the Lean statement recognizable against the printed lemma and only weakens the theorem, and the underscore keeps the linter honest rather than silencing it. Dropping it would be a quiet strengthening that no longer reads like the source.

Non-blocking observations (recorded, not required before merge):
N1. `Strategy.value_le_one` (Symmetrization.lean:39) restates `WinImplications.strategy_value_le_one` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Observables/WinImplications/AnticommutingObs.lean:543 on `github/main`), the same statement with a different proof. Reuse is impossible here without inverting the layering, since the Observables layer imports the Games layer; `dup_check.py` matches names, so it could not see it. The cleanup is to move the Games-layer lemma down and have `WinImplications` reuse it, in a later PR.
N2. StrategyClasses.lean:923-924 now has a double blank line left over from the move.
N3. The statement-level `\uses` of the new node (ch12_qpbt_games.tex:144) lists `lem:symmetric-strat-given-strategy`, which is a proof-level dependency; the statement needs only the three definitions. Harmless extra graph edge, blueprint-sync green.

PR 540 disposition evidence (the main session decides): 540 is open, docs-only (audits/2026-09-12_issue-524-symmetrization-obstruction.md and docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_symmetrization-attainment.tex), based on ae124f8f, CI failure at head f2f30dc0, one COMMENTED review from 2026-09-12. It is not superseded on substance: PR 601 adopts its empty-answer refutation as a boundary hypothesis but deliberately does not carry its evidence, and 601's new gap-note section points at "the separate documentation packet" for it. `github/main`'s gap note contains no mention of an empty answer, so retiring 540 would leave that cross-reference dangling and the only in-repo justification of the `Nonempty G.Answer` hypothesis would be the two docstrings and the blueprint sentence. My evidence favours keeping 540, rebased on main after 601 lands (its gap-note edits are in different sections, so the rebase should be mechanical) and its CI repaired; retiring it is defensible only if its audit and obstruction sections are first copied onto another branch.

Not checked: main-side declarations reused here beyond their axiom closure (`symmetrizedStrategy`, `projectiveDilation` and their value lemmas), the gap note prose against docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex line by line, the rendered blueprint PDF, and anything on PR 540's branch beyond its metadata and file list.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=APPROVED)

### Motivation

- Preserve PR 542's seed-indexed soundness proof under #527, corresponding to `lem:ld-soundness` in `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-438`. Main's public helper rename required a new branch to preserve the result without reverting that rename.

### Description

- Prove `exists_ld_soundness` for every simultaneity parameter with its public statement unchanged. Apply the existing direct-game theorem through the proved correlated seed dilation, compress the measurements, recover global agreement with the point-agreement branch and tuple collision bound, and absorb the error by changing the existential constants.
- Add three formalization auxiliaries and relocate the sampling/measurement block without changing its declarations or proofs, breaking the import cycle while retaining the public helper names.
- Keep the printed tensor-code correspondence, parameter-bound justification and downstream dimension application open under #527. This proof avoids the first two steps; it does not discharge their source-gap records. The source-labelled blueprint proof remains without a proof-level completion mark because it presents a different route.
- Record the declaration-level faithfulness audit in `audits/2026-09-18_seed-indexed-soundness-faithfulness-542.md`. Its provenance section retains the original PR 542 packet and author audit. PR 542 remains open until this replacement integrates.

### Testing

- Exact head `8e1c46b1e8ff92dbcce4ccbf2fde17c7c861c2d4`: all nine CI contexts passed in 385 seconds; statement-origin was skipped by its path filter.
- Rooted blueprint axiom audit: 1660 passing declarations, zero failures and two existing statement-level warnings; no proof-level marked declaration depends on `sorryAx`.
- Independent fresh Opus review 5246260120 checked the full diff, unchanged statement, source-shaped game, proved transport, relocation and standard-only axiom closures. APPROVED with zero unchecked findings; three minor documentation observations remain recorded as nonblocking in the review.
- MAIN accepts the complete proof after that independent faithfulness review. No extra hypothesis was introduced and the printed-route gaps remain explicit.

---
Addresses #527

<!-- mipstarre-review pr=600 head=8e1c46b1e8ff92dbcce4ccbf2fde17c7c861c2d4 -->
# Review - PR 600 @ 8e1c46b1e8ff92dbcce4ccbf2fde17c7c861c2d4

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 61d0ab1e21673dd6b6a729b62e28248bbad1f777. Two commits against base `main` (merge-base `2e253049`), 14 files, +934/-410: a `sorry` on the paper-labelled `exists_ld_soundness` is replaced by a complete proof for every simultaneity parameter, three formalization auxiliaries are added, a byte-identical block of sampling and measurement definitions is relocated into a new module to break an import cycle, and the paper-gap bookkeeping is updated.

## Findings

- [x] F1 (code; minor) audits/2026-09-18_seed-indexed-soundness-faithfulness-542.md:152 - section 3.3 claims to enumerate the relocated block but lists 17 of the 23 relocated declarations; `polyFuncFintype`, `PolyIndex`, `PolyMeas`, `PolyMeasFamily`, `PolyTuple` and `PolyMeasTuple` are omitted, and the last two appear in the reviewed theorem statement. Non-blocking: I verified independently that the entire relocated body is a contiguous byte-identical substring of main's file, so the claim is true and only the list is short. Fix if touched again: add the six names.
- [x] F2 (prose; minor) docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex:44 - the estimated-weight bullet now says the downstream use at dimension `2m+2` "remains separate from this transport" where it previously said it remains open. Non-blocking: the same note still says at :407 that it "still requires verification", and the audit section 5 lists it as open, so the register is not misleading overall; the bullet alone reads softer than the rest.
- [x] F3 (prose; minor) blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:277 - the deliberate withholding of the proof-level `\leanok` is recorded by a LaTeX comment that itself contains the token `\leanok`. Harmless to plasTeX and to `local-ci/blueprint-sync`, which is green at this head, but a grep-based counter sees 141 occurrences in the chapter against 140 on main. Non-blocking: rephrase the comment if any tooling ever counts by grep.

## Review

Statement integrity. `exists_ld_soundness` is byte-identical to main: the 27 lines from `theorem exists_ld_soundness :` through `:= by` diff empty against `2e253049` (md5 `26fcdbe8d71b50686533867350d1d272` on both sides) - same existential over `a b`, same `1 ≤ a`, `0 < b`, `b ≤ 1`, same `∀ (L : LdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε`, same `S : Strategy (ldGame L)` with `S.IsProjective` and `1 - ε ≤ S.value`, the same three `consistencyDefect` conclusions in the same order with the same bound `deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k`, the first two under `uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)` and the third under `uniformDistribution Unit`. `deltaLd` is byte-identical too; it only moved file. This matches `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-438` term by term, including the closing sentence that the first two approximations hold under the uniform law on `F_q^m` while the third has no question distribution. No hypothesis was added anywhere.

Proof integrity. From a probe file outside the worktree, against the worktree built at this head, `#print axioms` returns exactly `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` for `exists_ld_soundness`, `polyTupleAgreement_avg_le_mdq`, `ten_sqrt_deltaLd_le`, `error_and_collision_le_deltaLd` and `exists_direct_ld_soundness`. That closure is transitive, so every declaration in the chain - `ldStrategyToDirect` and its value and projectivity lemmas, the two compression-transfer lemmas, `ldPointPair_consistencyDefect_le`, `consistencyDefect_trans_le`, `directPolynomialAgreement_avg_le_mdq` - is fully proved with no `sorryAx` and no custom axiom. `lake build` of the four touched modules succeeds (9114 jobs, warnings only, pre-existing). The `sorry` that stood at `LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean:434` on main is gone and no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` was added anywhere in the tree; the remaining holes in `Combining/Apply.lean`, `Extraction/Consistency.lean`, `Games/StrategyClasses.lean` and `Test/Soundness.lean` are unchanged from main and are not in this chain. Anti-patterns A1-A6: none - no conclusion-shaped hypothesis, no `:= rfl` sleight, no zero-fallback branch (the `ldPointValuesOrZero` folding is main's, not introduced here), no default witness, no external `*Statement` input.

Faithfulness of the definition, as asked. The theorem quantifies over `Strategy (ldGame L)`, and `ldGame` (`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/LowDegreeGame.lean:757`, blueprint `def:ld-game`) is the source-shaped seed-indexed game, unchanged by this PR. It is *not* the repository's directly indexed game: the direct game appears only inside the proof, reached through the correlated seed dilation `ldStrategyToDirect` whose value equality `ldStrategyToDirect_value_eq` and projectivity preservation are proved, not assumed. So this is the favourable case - the proved statement is about the paper's game, and the direct game is an internal device. The proof does not encode the unsupported tensor-code correspondence in a definition.

Route. `exists_direct_ld_soundness` is applied to the dilated strategy; both polynomial measurements are compressed by `seedFiberCompressPolyMeasTuple`; the two mixed relations transfer exactly by rewriting with the two compression lemmas; the global relation is rebuilt from those two plus the point-agreement branch (weight `1/9`, hence `9ε`) through `consistencyDefect_trans_le`, plus `polyTupleAgreement_avg_le_mdq`, which bounds the collision probability of two *distinct* polynomial tuples at a uniform point by `m d / q` by choosing one differing coordinate - no union bound, so no degradation in `k`, and no contact with the coordinatewise route refuted in `qpbt_ld-simultaneous-sandwich.tex`, since it only bounds collisions of already-constructed tuples. The resulting `E + 2√(9ε+E) + md/q` is absorbed by `(a,b) → (10a, b/2)` via `ten_sqrt_deltaLd_le`, with the `ε > 1` and `E > 1` branches closed by the unit bound on bipartite consistency defects. The two `SeedError` lemmas are pure real arithmetic about `deltaLd` and alter nothing the paper states. All three new declarations are honestly labelled as auxiliaries with no paper counterpart.

Relocation and imports. The body of the new `Test/LowDegreeGameMeasurements.lean` is a contiguous byte-identical substring of main's `LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean`: 23 declarations, none lost, none re-stated. Its imports are `Games.Consistency`, `Games.DistributionMarginals`, `Games.StrategyClasses`, `Games.TypedCondLinear`, `Observables.LineDefs`, `Test.LowDegreeGame` - no `Combining.*`, so no cycle, confirmed by the successful build. The five retargeted files (`QPBT.lean`, `Combining/Defs.lean`, `DirectLowDegree/Game.lean`, `Combining/ErrorBounds.lean`, `Test/Completeness.lean`) change import lines only; `Test/Completeness.lean` changes no statement. `SeedIndexedSoundness.lean` changes one docstring sentence. File lengths 224 / 384 / 105 lines, within style; `local-ci/file-length` green.

Source-gap bookkeeping. The two open imports - the claimed tensor-code game correspondence, and `K ≥ 12·m·(d+1)` for the printed `K = m³d` - are restated as open under issue 527 in the theorem docstring (`LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean:59-64`), in `qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` ("avoids rather than discharges the two source-import obligations"), in `qpbt_ld-simultaneous-sandwich.tex`, in the gap register row, and in audit section 5. Neither the PR body nor any docstring claims the unsupported import is discharged; the word used throughout is "avoided". No bridge, residual, witness or proof-obligation hypothesis was added. Stale trackers 16 and 210 were corrected to 527.

Blueprint. The statement-level `\leanok` on `lem:ld-soundness` (with `\lean{MIPStarRE.QPBT.deltaLd, MIPStarRE.QPBT.exists_ld_soundness}`) is untouched and remains accurate, since the statement is unchanged. No proof-level `\leanok` was added: the only new occurrence of the token in the chapter is inside the explanatory comment at :277 (see F3). `local-ci/blueprint-sync` is green. I agree with withholding it: the proof block transcribes the printed tensor-code route, whose two obligations are open, so a proof-level mark there would certify a route the formalization does not follow - the marker means "this blueprint proof is formalized", not "this statement is proved". My recommendation to the main session is to keep it withheld and, when the node is next edited, to split the node rather than mark it: keep the printed route in the paper-labelled proof unmarked, and put the formalized route into a separate formalization-support node carrying the proof-level mark and `\uses` of the direct-route declarations. The added paragraph at the head of the proof block already states plainly which route Lean follows, so nothing is overclaimed in the meantime.

Audit. `audits/2026-09-18_seed-indexed-soundness-faithfulness-542.md` lists the changed declaration and the three new ones with file:line (all four line references check out against the head files), paper locators, hypothesis lists and axiom columns, and separates relocated declarations; it matches the diff apart from F1. Its statement-comparison points (error function, conclusion order, quantifier order, boundary encoding) check out against the paper text.

CI and prior reviews. `gh api .../commits/8e1c46b1/status` is `success` with all nine contexts green, including `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion` and `blueprint-sync`. There are no earlier marked reviews on this PR, so there were no prior findings to re-check; PR 542 has none either.

PR 542 disposition, evidence for the main session. 542 is still open at `ac7cd808`, never reviewed, based on `ae124f8f`, and its branch predates main's rename of `map_uniformDistribution_seed` to `uniformDistribution_map_ldSeed` inside the exact block it relocates, so it can no longer be merged without a content regression. Every Lean and blueprint file it touches is carried here, plus two files it lacks (`MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean`, `Test/Completeness.lean`), and `dup_check` reports no duplicate on main. On that evidence 542 is fully superseded on substance. One thing it carries that this PR does not is its author-side audit `audits/2026-09-12-issue-527-ld-soundness.md`; if 542 is closed as superseded, that file never reaches main, so I would either copy it into this branch or accept the section 6 provenance pointer as the record. I do not make the call.

Not checked: the correctness of declarations already on main that this PR only reuses (`exists_direct_ld_soundness` and the transport stack) beyond their axiom closure; the paper-gap prose against `docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex` line by line; the rendered blueprint PDF.
